integrity: Analytical proof accompanied by a self-contained supplementary finite arithmetic/Sturm script. Finite computations are not a substitute for the asymptotic proof. No independent audit or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Results concern the normalized classical analytic Bergman disk and the fixed-parameter Jacobi operator. In the range \(0<s<1/2\) the exact threshold is \(1/\|J_s\|\) without a closed formula. Asymptotics are not uniform near either endpoint. Spectral type inside the essential interval is unclassified. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: The half-power spectral transition and Coulomb edge law for Bergman Toeplitz perturbations
